decisions.M2: The report permits documenting the server limit. prior_consent remains a client pre-grant; PHP blocking is deliberately stricter under an opt-in law. REST description and README state this limit.
decisions.L10: Legacy created_at remains site time for compatibility; created_at_gmt supplies RFC 3339 UTC, the schema is accurate, and cleanup uses the same site clock as storage.
decisions.G3: FAZ does not generate GPP. Unsupported ruleset/schema declarations were removed. External CMP strings are captured using ping, bounded by a timeout and a pagehide flush.

integration_regressions: Namespaced compact vendor and Right-to-Object records survive A → B → A.
The PHP geo comparator uses the multisite fingerprint and the namespaced DNSMPI signal.
PMP necessary-only exemption cannot authorize an optional grant from another scope.
Decision/ID snapshot, fresh TC string, passive GPP, unload flush and stale-token recovery coexist in the logger.
Forged parking attributes cannot exempt a live iframe src.
A JSON assignment to location is evaluated as code.
not_in_scope: The 5 refuted findings in section 3 require no corrective change.
Headless content.rendered and translation-provider language resolution were explicitly unverified in the source report and are not included in the 56 entries.
